from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document's identifier and its assigned legal cause."""
    title: str = Field(description="The document's title as found in the text")
    cause_category: Literal['破坏社会主义市场经济秩序罪', '不动产登记纠纷', '渎职罪', '侵权责任纠纷', '执行案由-先予执行', '行政行为-行政复议'] = Field(description="The legal cause category assigned to this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
